verdict.rationale: Relay's own materials say you can issue debit or credit cards to team members (up to 50 virtual or physical), set spend limits, and define roles. That covers the core of per-employee card spend limits, but only through brief marketing lines with no detail on how limits work per card or what other controls exist. The Trustpilot mention of 'problems with prescribed limits' is too vague to count as a concrete contradiction, so it lowers confidence rather than the verdict. Missing for 10: explicit per-card limit configuration docs, granular controls such as merchant/category restrictions or limit periods, and independent hands-on confirmation of employee-level card controls.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can set per-card spend limits and granular controls for each employee
